{{Top|leg}}
The '''Duran feather lily''' was an exotic plant. Specimens of the Duran feather lily were kept at the [[Lonatran Gardens]] on [[Lonatro]] where the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] kept rare or otherwise extinct species to preserve their genetic line.<ref name="The Gree Enclave">{{JournalCite|8|The Gree Enclave}}</ref>
